arguments.sql:
SELECT h.publisher_id, COUNT(*) AS characters, COUNT(r.race) AS with_race_value,
       SUM(r.race = '-') AS dash_values, SUM(TRIM(r.race) = '') AS blank_values,
       GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT r.race) AS race_values
FROM main.superhero AS h
LEFT JOIN main.race AS r ON r.id = h.race_id
WHERE h.publisher_id IN (SELECT publisher_id FROM main.superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'A-Bomb')
GROUP BY h.publisher_id
